svg.title: World visitor map
svg.metadata: Natural Earth 5.1.1, public domain. Complete unlabeled world map using the India point-of-view country dataset. India includes Kashmir, Arunachal Pradesh, Aksai Chin and Shaksgam. Tibet is CN-XZ intersected with the China polygon and excluding India, drawn with a dashed border and no visible label. No foreign raster background or regional overlay is used. The same asset is used in the thumbnail and expanded map. Sources: https://www.naturalearthdata.com/downloads/10m-cultural-vectors/ ; https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/10m/cultural/ne_10m_admin_0_countries_ind.zip ; https://naciscdn.org/naturalearth/10m/cultural/ne_10m_admin_1_states_provinces.zip Projection: MapMyVisitors world_mill_en, Miller, radius 6381372, central meridian 11.5, projected bbox [-20004297.151525836,-12671671.123330014,20026572.39474939,6930392.02513512].
